assets.brief: Faithful front elevation of Xianlin Duxia Library, paired curved silver wings, vertical fins, glass middle entrance and broad steps. Match existing restrained watercolor and pencil campus art; full building within margins, no lettering or invented traditional tower.

Faithful overhead Xiangxuehai garden: dark pavilion roof with extending ridges, curving pale paths, plum trees and right-side wall. Preserve the photograph layout; soft watercolor, no invented lake or pagoda.
Open cream linen scrapbook on pale oak under leafy window shadows; blank fibrous pages, real binding, complete corners, no text, photos, pockets or grid.

Complete handmade pop-up garden book on a window desk at blue hour, paper paths, tree, house and flower layers. Closed leaf-sealed envelope on lower left; blank lower-right page with a tiny winding socket. Preserve the page geometry for a separate movable transparent crank.

Near-overhead warm student desk. Closed sage textbook with empty title label at upper left; Duxia postcard painted into top middle; cup and plant at upper right. Clear rubbing paper at x35..90%,y33..81%, pencil alongside and a partly exposed engraved architectural plate. Remove unrelated floral engraving; preserve blank paper and faint graphite scratches.

Transparent soft graphite frottage of the whole Duxia facade: curved wings, fins, recessed glass center, stairs and light shrubs. Broken hatching and pencil grain, no sky, lettering or paper background; retain all building edges.
